description: Per-Z=8 shard of the recursive atom-knot atlas. Element: O. Covers every (Z=8, N) in AME 2020. Each row carries: prediction_type ∈ {mass, binding_energy}; the prediction value (from L1 canonical |tr_M| via markov_peel+mpmath, OR L2 α-cluster recursion); the AME 2020 reference; err in MeV / % / ppm; L4 composite mass M = N·m_n + Z·m_p − B (when nucleon masses + B are available); and Wave-2 Corrected Photon (Form-B Bring–Schwinger cubic alpha_EM(q_2t)), Two-Term Categorical Lagrangian Trace (M = M_QCD + M_QED at consistent q_2t), exact 4x4 Hankel Plancherel Z_{3A}^{(4)}(q_2t), and 3D stacked alpha-simplex + E_0^tower binding. L1 source: canonical-mass-table-extended.witness.json; L2 source: alpha/alpha-cluster-recursion.witness.json; nucleon masses: m-p-substrate-identity-50dps.witness.json.
